topics.title: US-Iran pause opens room for talks
topics.summary: Mediators say there is progress toward easing U.S.-Iran tensions after both sides paused attacks. Talks are focused on preventing a wider conflict and restoring safer movement through the Strait of Hormuz.
topics.discussionPrompt: When a tense situation suddenly gets a pause button, what would you do first: talk, take a breather, or make a backup plan?

topics.title: Oil prices cool after tensions ease
topics.summary: Oil prices fell as markets reacted to the pause in U.S.-Iran hostilities. Investors are also watching a busy week of central bank decisions, inflation data and major company earnings.
topics.discussionPrompt: Is it weird how one diplomatic pause can ripple into gas prices, stocks and dinner-table budgets? What everyday price do you notice first?

topics.title: UNESCO adds Olympus and D-Day beaches
topics.summary: UNESCO added Greece's Mount Olympus and France's D-Day landing beaches to its World Heritage List. The designations recognize cultural, natural and historical importance while raising preservation responsibilities.
topics.discussionPrompt: If a place becomes a world heritage site, does that make it feel more like a museum, a shared treasure, or both?

topics.title: Study looks at earlier eating windows
topics.summary: A preliminary study suggests older women who ate within a shorter daytime window performed better on some thinking tests. Researchers say larger peer-reviewed studies are needed before drawing firm conclusions.
topics.discussionPrompt: Would you shift dinner earlier for a possible brain boost, or is the late snack part of your personality at this point?
